ModMetaData.name: Disable Steam Mods
ModMetaData.author: NemuruYama
ModMetaData.description:
Prepatcher-based test utility that prevents RimWorld from loading subscribed Steam Workshop mods, except this mod's own Workshop copy.
Disclaimer: The preview image is generated by AI. I wanted the page to have a preview image and did not have a custom one ready; without AI generation, this item simply would not have had a preview image. No existing artwork or artist commission was replaced. The mod itself does not use live generative AI or AI-generated runtime content. This disclaimer was generated with AI.
